objective: Provide affordable crop insurance and comprehensive risk cover to farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
description: Launched from Kharif 2016. Optional for all farmers including KCC holders (loanee farmers can opt out at least 7 days before cut-off date). Covers food crops, oilseeds, annual commercial/horticultural crops. Risks covered: drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, widespread pest/disease, landslides, natural fire, storms, hailstorms, cyclones. Prevented sowing/mid-season adversity/post-harvest (up to 2 weeks) coverage. Localized calamities covered. Exclusions: war, nuclear risks, malicious damage, preventable risks. Technology: YES-TECH, CROPIC App, CCE Agri App. Portal: National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP).
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
